name: @emsenn/computing-with-emacs
description: Computing with Emacs as a boundary system: the cockpit topology — agent endpoints, monitorable context/hook streams, and the resolved pane plan — modeled as data, projected to CLI/OpenAPI/MCP/web from one dispatcher, and realized into Emacs windows by a generic elisp consumer. Environment specifics live in a cockpit config, never in code.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && chmod +x dist/scripts/*.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
